instruction: A candid documentary medium shot of a professional meeting indoors. On the left, the man in the dark blue shirt (R3) is seen in profile, leaning forward over a white desk to shake hands. On the right, the short-haired woman in the pink blazer (R2) extends her arm to complete the handshake. Seated in the center background, the blonde woman in the black sleeveless top (R1) smiles warmly as she watches the interaction. The bright office setting features clean white walls and a laptop on the table. Soft, even indoor lighting illuminates the scene, creating a clean, professional atmosphere with a shallow depth of field.
